items.title: api.rjmlaird.co.uk

items.title: apps.rjmlaird.co.uk
items.description: The catalogue and presentation layer for maintained applications, which are classified once and linked by relationship.

items.title: booking.rjmlaird.co.uk
items.description: The booking integration boundary: service listing, booking intents and hand-off to the scheduling and payment providers.

items.title: cdn.rjmlaird.co.uk

items.title: data.rjmlaird.co.uk
items.description: A curated, attributed, read-only public reference-data API, distinct from the portfolio and estate catalogue API.

items.title: dev.rjmlaird.co.uk
items.description: A reserved hostname for developer-facing resources and release workflow. Nothing is deployed.

items.title: docs.rjmlaird.co.uk
items.description: The public documentation site for the digital estate, built with Docusaurus and deployed to GitHub Pages.

items.title: labs.rjmlaird.co.uk
items.description: Experimental and exploratory work, kept clearly separate from production apps and tools.

items.title: rjmlaird.co.uk
items.description: The canonical public site for the rjmlaird.co.uk brand, writing, research, projects and contact routes.

items.title: status.rjmlaird.co.uk
items.description: Curated public reporting of the health of public services, hosted independently of what it reports on.

items.title: tools.rjmlaird.co.uk
items.description: The catalogue and presentation layer for reusable utilities, which are classified once and linked by relationship.
